{{For|[[The Final Act Event]]}} {{ModeInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:TheFinalApproachIcon.png]] |-|Full Icon = [[File:TheFinalApproachBanner.png]] |chapter = TDS: Origins |previous_mission = [[Surface Tension]] |next_mission = [[Lights Out]] }} ==Description== '''The Final Approach''' is a cutscene for the first chapter of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. It happens after [[Surface Tension]] concludes. ==Cutscene== [[File:The Final Approach (Chapter 1- Cutscene 3)|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
As the remaining agents are fending the zombies off in a quarry, the [[Commander]] urges them to come to it. The Recruit, survivors and [[Trapper]] get there first without being told to by him. The [[Commander]] first persuades [[Soldier]]. Shortly after the [[Sniper]] comes there. Once nearly everyone got onto the platform, the [[Trapper]] threw a landmine at a zombie, causing an explosion. Once the platform begins going up, the [[Minigunner]] quickly jumps onto it. Everyone keeps on attacking zombies for a few seconds, though they stop once the platform has gone up high enough. The [[Soldier]], worried about [[Hops]] and [[Demoman]], suggests waiting for them, though the [[Commander]] shuts the idea down due to the area being full of zombies.
